name: Haypp Group AB (publ)
summary: Haypp Group AB (publ), an e-commerce company, engages in the sale of nicotine pouches and snus products in Sweden, Norway, Europe, and the United States. The company operates through three segments: Core, Growth, and Emerging. It engages in the sale of oral nicotine products; and marketing space and research services for its products. The company also offers products through various e-commerce platforms, including haypp.com, nicokick.com, snushjem.no, snusbolaget.se, snus.com, snusmarkt.ch, northerner.com, snuslageret.no, snusnetto.se, vapeglobe.de, and nettotobak.com.
